name: Naga, Candide
body:
NAGA, CANDIDE
CR 7

XP 3,200
CN Large aberration (psionic, shapechanger)
Init +9; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +18; Aura disillusionment 20 ft.

DEFENSE

AC 20 touch 14, flat-footed 16 (+5 Dex, +6 natural, –1 size)
hp 76 (8d8+40)
Fort +7, Ref +7, Will +9; +4 vs. illusion and mind-affecting effects
Immune morale bonuses

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +10 (2d8+7)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 10 ft.
Special Attacks psionic fist +1
Egoist Powers Known (ML 5th; power points; 32; DC 13 + power level; concentration +8)

Talents-create sound, detect psionics, far hand
1st-control light, corrosive aura, hammer, inertial armor, thicken skin
2nd-concealing amorpha, concussion blast, detect hostile intent, recall agony
3rd-dispel psionics, expose weakness

STATISTICS

Str 20, Dex 21, Con 20, Int 16, Wis 16, Cha 15
Base Atk +6; CMB +12; CMD 27 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Empower Power, Improved Initiative, Psionic Meditation, Psionic Fist
Skills Autohypnosis +14, Knowledge (arcana) +14, Knowledge (history) +14, Perception +14, Sense Motive +14, Spellcraft +14, Use Magic Device +13
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic
SQ adopted talent, change shape (metamorphosis, ML 5th)

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Adopted Talent (Ex)

Whenever the candide naga uses change shape to assume a new form, it gains maximum skill ranks in a single skill of its choice for the duration of its change. Any skill which becomes trained as a result of adopted talent is considered a class skill for the candide naga.

Aura of Disillusionment (Su)

The candide naga and all creatures within 20 feet of them develop a keener perception of reality at the expense of their optimism.

Creatures within the aura (including the candide naga) gain a +4 insight bonus on Perception checks and saving throws against illusion and mind-affecting effects. However, they cannot benefit from morale bonuses while affected by this ability. This is a mind-affecting effect.

Psionic Powers

A candide naga manifests powers as a 5th-level egoist.

ABOUT

In a land as mired in tradition and propaganda as Eigenel, the backlash against such ingrained assumptions can be stark and disconcerting. Born of psionic scaled peoples spurned for their unusual power, candide naga wrap themselves in sobering telepathic veils as their three keen eyes and adaptive form dissect the structures others may view as absolute.
